key_source_facts: CCResult.sel_slot is set unconditionally but equals -1 on single-candidate trials: -1 means not applicable, and must be written as explicit absence
sel_slot is the SAMPLED channel, not the argmax, so it is meaningful even with learning disabled
queried is the identity at the INTENDED slot, not at the selected slot; presented[] is needed to reconstruct what was attended
intended_bank must be computed driver-side (R-majority) because the engine must never see the task index
bank_score_margin is reproducible from ccRouterWeights(); no new accessor needed
update mass is reproducible from ccBankWeights(); the harness already snapshots it in L10.1 telemetry
advantage requires snapshotting reward_baseline BEFORE runCCTrial, which updates it internally
no SHA-256 exists in C++; state dumps are hashed by the runner instead of adding crypto code
legacy aggregate CSVs use -1.0 as a not-measured sentinel (observed cross_novel=-1.000000), the anti-pattern the L11 schema forbids

feasibility_probe.establishes: every schema field except the missing arms is reachable without any engine change; instrumentation can be harness-only
feasibility_probe.does_not_establish: that a writer reproduces legacy output, that non-interference holds, or that any L11 arm exists

non_interference.reason: the instrumentation-enabled half of the comparison does not exist without R3

disabled_side_measured.conclusion: legacy output is deterministic, so a future on/off difference will be attributable to the instrumentation rather than to noise

blocked_checks: independent reconstruction of the instrumentation records
non_interference.stronger_requirement_adopted: the prepared design writes a separate trials11_*.csv, so legacy artifacts are untouched rather than merely equal

metric_reconstruction.improvement_over_L11_1: grouping by (task, eval_call) instead of task, because eval_kind=0 evaluates a task in several calls (per-task counts were 360/240/120 instead of 120 each)
metric_reconstruction.effect_on_L11_1_finding: none - the eval_kind=4 arm has exactly one call per task, so its per-task means were already correct

results.sentinel_handling: legacy -1.0 reported as NOT_MEASURED_in_harness, never averaged

metric_reconstruction.traceability: each number is reproducible from a named file, a named command and an explicit metric column argument

defects_found_in_new_tooling: v2 reconstructor initially did not accept gzip input - fixed in place
per-task grouping was insufficient for multi-call categories - fixed in place

schema_gaps_found: six L11 cue categories require arms that do not exist
model_hash should be produced by an external hash step

official_evaluation.note: the only executions were two runs of the UNMODIFIED harness default arm for determinism, and one single-trial API probe

remaining_blockers.blocker: 26/26 battery not rerun on an instrumented binary

remaining_blockers.owner_action: separate authorized diagnostic, still PROPOSED / NOT EXECUTED

limitations: no implementation was performed, so no instrumentation claim is made
non-interference cannot be claimed from the disabled-side determinism alone
the feasibility probe exercises the API surface, not a full writer
the L11 arms do not exist; instrumentation alone cannot produce an official result
the 26/26 battery status is inherited and unverified for this milestone
recommended_next_step: on R3: implement the prepared change behind --emit-l11, run the per-trial non-interference test before implementing any arm; then request R1 and R2, then a separate authorized preflight review before any official L11 run
